# ACES CUSAT

> ACES (Association of Computer Engineering Students) is the student association of the Division of Computer Engineering, School of Engineering, Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT), Kochi, Kerala, India. Student-run since 2006. 400+ members.

## What ACES does

- Hands-on workshops (Git, VS Code, DevOps, cybersecurity, UI/UX)
- Talks and sessions with alumni and industry engineers
- Placement preparation: resume sessions, mock interviews (HireUp, with every SOE association)
- Ideathons and hackathons (Ignite Ideas, Foundry), tech fest participation, first-year sessions
- Study materials and previous-year question papers for CUSAT B.Tech Computer Engineering (2019 and 2023 schemes)
- A newsletter and the division's placement brochure

## Pages

- [Home](https://acescusat.tech/): who we are and what's on
- [Achievements](https://acescusat.tech/achievements): hackathon wins, ideathon prizes, internships
- [Events](https://acescusat.tech/events): upcoming and past events
- [Materials](https://acescusat.tech/materials): notes and question papers by scheme and semester
- [Placements](https://acescusat.tech/placements): placement statistics, recruiters, testimonials, brochure PDF
- [Newsletter](https://acescusat.tech/newsletter): issues of the department newsletter
- [Team](https://acescusat.tech/team): the 2026–27 team and faculty
